description: Reconstructed extents of the Ocean Infinity 2025-2026 MH370 seabed search and related areas. Public sources only; see SOURCE.md. NO official polygon or coordinates were published.
format: Each entry: rings = list of closed rings [[lon,lat],...] (WGS84, decimal degrees); multiple rings are separate parts (no holes). area_km2 computed after 1-km geodesic densification with pyproj Geod (WGS84), EPSG:6933 and a local Albers (lat_1=-33, lat_2=-36.5). extent.s_km/n_km are along-arc / normal (+SE) distances relative to the sea-level 7th arc of mh370.geo (s=0 at 34.2342 S).

official_figures.note: Day count restarts at signing: Days 1-4 = 25-28 Mar 2025, Day 5 = 31 Dec 2025; cumulative before 1 Jan 2026 = 1,655.58 km2 (Mar 2025 + 31 Dec). Areas are line-km x swath tallies, not polygon areas.

polygons.name: OI_contract_area_best__slide_digitised
polygons.source: Ocean Infinity slide '2024 Proposed Search Area ~15,000km2, Extending out ~45nm from 7th arc' (shown 3 Mar 2024; copy: mh370.radiantphysics.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/searcharea-1.png); digitised in this work
polygons.notes: BEST ESTIMATE of the ~15,000 km2 'no find, no fee' contract area (MOT: 'a new area estimated at 15,000 km2'), assumed identical to OI's March-2024 proposal (two strips outside the ATSB+OI-2018 coverage, ~33-36 S). Slide has no graticule: registered to the slide's own dotted 7th arc, the IG-hotspot square and the OI-2018 coverage edges. Edge errors ~2-3 km (scale +/-1%, arc offset +/-1.1 km, 1 px ~1 km), strip ends ~5 km. Total 14,861 km2 vs nominal ~15,000. That the signed contract polygon equals this slide is an ASSUMPTION (no official map published).

polygons.name: OI_contract_area_alt__CAPTION_kml
polygons.source: mh370-caption.net 'Search areas.kmz' (placemarks 'Ocean Infinity proposed 2024 area'); CAPTION states coordinates 'drawn from the presentation given at the 10th anniversary ceremony'
polygons.notes: Machine-readable but itself a hand digitisation of the same slide by CAPTION. Open linestrings closed here with a straight inner edge. Relative to the slide digitisation its SE outer edge is ~5-6 km further out (n~99 km) and its NW outer edge agrees (n~-74 km). Total 15,812 km2.

polygons.name: OI_contract_area_alt__Iannello_map_digitised
polygons.source: Red 'OI proposed search' outline on V. Iannello maps of 4 Mar 2025 and 31 Mar 2025 (radiantphysics 2025/03 image-1, image-4, image-9)
polygons.notes: Georeferencing of the maps is good to ~1 km (validated with AIS), but the red outline is Iannello's own rendering of the OI proposal. NW outer edge ~6 km further out than slide/CAPTION (n~-80 km); SE outer edge agrees with slide (n~93.6 km). Total 16,863 km2.

polygons.name: OI2025_26_surveyed_post_contract_best
polygons.source: Constructed: AIS tracks (CAPTION KMLs) + MOT/AAIB area figures + OI daily reports + slide inner edge
polygons.notes: Best-estimate footprint of the ~7,571 km2 counted by MOT/AAIB for the two post-signing phases (Phase 1: 25-28 Mar 2025, Armada 78 06; Phase 2: 31 Dec 2025-23 Jan 2026, Armada 86 05; 28 days). SE (outer) side of the 7th arc only. s from -135.0 to 88.0 km; inner edge = previous-coverage edge (slide); outer edge n = 99.3 km CHOSEN so area = 7,571.46 km2 (AIS ship positions reach n = 100-103 km, i.e. beyond the proposal's ~93-95 km outer edge, consistent with Iannello's remark that the Mar-2025 work was 'wider than the area proposed'). Errors: ends +/-10 km, outer edge +/-5 km. Note the official figure is a line-km x swath (~1.82 km) tally, not a polygon area.

polygons.name: OI2025_26_surveyed_post_contract_AIS_envelope
polygons.notes: Same as best estimate but outer edge fixed at n = 101 km from the AIS envelope instead of calibrated to the official area.

polygons.name: OI2025_pre_contract_SW_survey_Mar11-24
polygons.source: Constructed from AIS track of Armada 78 06, 11-24 Mar 2025 (CAPTION KML) + Iannello 31 Mar 2025 post
polygons.notes: Pre-signing survey (MOT: 'additional survey activities were undertaken within the broader search area before the formal signing'). New ground SE of the arc, from the SW end of the proposal's SE strip (~35.6-36.1 S) to ~36.6 S, i.e. partly OUTSIDE the March-2024 proposal ('starting further southwest and wider than the area proposed' - Iannello). Envelope n = 63/66-101 km; area not published; AUV coverage inside the envelope may be incomplete.

polygons.name: OI2025_26_all_new_ground_SE_of_arc
polygons.source: Union of the two previous entries
polygons.notes: All 2025-26 new-ground coverage (pre- and post-contract) SE of the 7th arc, 11 Mar 2025-23 Jan 2026. Use this (not the contractual 7,571 km2 piece) for search-POD purposes.

polygons.name: OI2025_pre_contract_infill_region_Feb23-28
polygons.source: Convex hull of Armada 78 06 hourly AIS positions (SOG<6 kn), 23 Feb 12:00-28 Feb 06:00 UTC 2025
polygons.notes: NOT a coverage polygon: region inside which infill sorties targeted ATSB/OI-2018 data holidays and low-quality data (incl. the High Priority Search Area). Actual infill patches unknown (likely a small fraction of the hull). Re-scan of previously searched ground, not new area.

polygons.name: OI2025_26_remaining_unsearched_NW_strip_slide
polygons.source: Ocean Infinity slide '2024 Proposed Search Area ~15,000km2, Extending out ~45nm from 7th arc' (shown 3 Mar 2024; copy: mh370.radiantphysics.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/searcharea-1.png); digitised in this work
polygons.notes: Inner (NW) strip of the proposal: no Armada AIS positions there in either post-contract phase; commenters describe the remaining area as 'the rectangle on the inside of the 7th arc'. Slide area 6,902 km2 vs MOT 'remaining 7,428.54 km2' (which is simply 15,000 - 7,571.46).

polygons.name: OI2025_26_remaining_NW_strip_calibrated_7428
polygons.source: Slide geometry with outer edge calibrated
polygons.notes: NW strip with constant outer edge n = -77.2 km solved so area = 7,428.54 km2 (slide outer edge -73 to -77 km; CAPTION -74.5; Iannello -80).

polygons.name: High_Priority_Search_Area_HPSA
polygons.source: V. Iannello 11 Feb 2023 'A High Priority Area to Search for MH370' (Priority-Area-Zoom.png)
polygons.notes: Seabed missed by GO Phoenix (terrain avoidance) and NW of OI-2018 AUV boundary; published 30.5 km2 around 34.53 S 93.84 E; digitised parts sum to ~25 km2 (small NE patches not captured). Reportedly scanned by Armada 78 06 in the pre-contract infill phase 23-28 Feb 2025 (Iannello 4 & 31 Mar 2025).

polygons.name: GO_Phoenix_terrain_gap_near_HPSA_CAPTION
polygons.notes: Four polygons (55.4 km2) = the whole slope area missed by GO Phoenix near 34.53 S 93.84 E (Iannello: 60.3 km2 of which ~half later scanned by OI in 2018).

polygons.name: CAPTION_Blelly_Marchand_recommended_zone
polygons.notes: CAPTION recommended zone (centred ~35.7 S 93.0 E). Lies in the SE strip SW end / SW extension; covered mostly in the pre-contract Mar-2025 work and at the start of Phase 2 (CAPTION: Phase 3 'includes the recommended zone by CAPTION'). Part of the triangle beyond n~99 km (its SE corner at n~115 km) may not have been covered.

polygons.name: Ulich_Iannello_2023_70NM_glide_racetrack
polygons.source: Black outline 'Ulich-Iannello Search Area Based on 70-NM Glide' on Iannello maps (4 & 31 Mar 2025)
polygons.notes: Stadium fitted to outline pixels in two georeferenced maps: radius 143.6 km (~77.5 NM), axis along the arc through ~LEP, half-length 56 km (+/-6). A recommendation, not a searched area.

polygons.name: Bluefin21_2014_pinger_area_PLACEHOLDER
polygons.source: JACC/ATSB 2014 statements via Wikipedia ('Search for Malaysia Airlines Flight 370'): 860 km2 sonar survey, 14 Apr-28 May 2014; position only as 'approx. 21 S 104 E' (no coordinates retrieved)
polygons.notes: PLACEHOLDER only (equal-area circle, r=16.5 km, at an approximate position). ~1,500 km NNE of the 2025-26 area. Note: with the sea-level arc of mh370.geo, 21 S 104 E lies ~2 km from the 7th arc (arc at 104.02 E), so it is NOT clearly off-arc; it was chosen from the 2014 pinger detections (later judged not from MH370) and discounted by ATSB in May 2014. North of all later systematic searches (OI 2018 reached 24.84 S).
